main_body: Stone well base under a snow-covered roof, with a dark water opening and a bucket inside
top_band: Light grey stone back rim at about rows 16-17, then a dark opening ellipse at rows 17-22 with a brown bucket. The snow roof at rows 1-9 is a separate, lighter band.
evidence: The well opening is drawn as a dark elliptical interior with a visible bucket and rim, seen from above. Below it, a stone front face (rows 23-30) has dark mortar courses. The roof overhang shades the area beneath it, and the snow roof reads as a lighter horizontal band over its own front face. This matches the reference roofed well.

style.evidence: The snow has white, pale blue and slate steps with icicles, the wood posts have 3-4 tones, and the stone has several greys. The outlines lean brown or blue-grey, not pure black. Texture is moderate. The lower stone front is a little flat, with dark bands over a plain grey fill, so it is slightly thinner than the Beodeul well. It would still sit acceptably beside the reference.
